name: the marker-only exemption is gone, so re-marking a backlog row is judged whole

name: any line with a marker is exempt, so a marker plus a changed word slips through
expect: ⭐ a marker PLUS a changed word is judged whole, and hits

name: a marker-only line is judged on nothing, so a plan run hidden inside the marker passes
expect: the marker itself is still judged — a plan run inside a marker hits

name: the marker exemption reads removed lines from EVERY file, not the line's own
expect: the exemption is per FILE: the same removed line in another file exempts nothing
